power.method: PoE (IEEE 802.3af / 802.3at Type 1, Class 3) and/or 12 VDC auxiliary

features: 3-9 mm automatic varifocal (AVF) SR lens, IR corrected
HDR / extended dynamic range mode 120 dB (108 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Audio line in/out, 2 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (nin_7300_data_sheet_enus_22459002123.pdf, V26 2022), linked from the IQSIGHT product page. 2MP (1080p) version with 3-9 mm lens. Suffix S = supplied with surface mount box (NIN-73023-A3A = same camera for flush mounting, 0.85 kg). Sensitivity (0.0104 lx color / 0.0039 lx mono) measured per IEC 62676 Part 5 at 1/25, F1.2. Datasheet ordering text marks both "NDAA compliant" (ndaa_compliant left unset per project convention).

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
